description: TOSCA node type used to write a dependent resource in the template, from the last words of its normalized name (its head noun). It says how a resource is written, not which resources a service requires. Default: tosca.nodes.Root. type_properties lists the properties that each normative type defines (TOSCA 1.3): a value of the policy vocabulary that the type does not define is written in the metadata of the node (policy_properties), so that the template stays valid for a TOSCA parser.
